Here is why this is the most effective path for you:
• Trust the "Stomach" Feeling: That solid, quiet conviction in your stomach is the true "foundation stone" or "satisfactory feeling" needed to impress the subconscious. The loud, anxious thoughts in your head are merely the "natural man" relying on the senses, which you must disregard.
• Avoid Reverse Effort: Forcing yourself to "stay inside" a visualization when it causes frustration triggers the "law of reverse effort," which can produce the opposite of your desire. Successful prayer is "attention minus effort".
• The Power of the Lullaby: Neville specifically recommends condensing your desire into a short phrase that implies fulfillment—like "llevamos 2 años"—and repeating it over and over in a drowsy state until the single sensation of relief dominates your mind.
• Naturalness is the Fast-Track: The time it takes for a manifestation to occur is directly proportionate to how natural it feels to already have it. Because this sentence already feels "solid and steady" to you, it is the most potent "seed" you can plant.
Tonight, as you drift off, simply repeat your phrase until you are possessed by that quiet feeling of relief."
